summary: F-03 implemented. In `_generate_photo`, each step result now gets `narration = placed` when a vision caption took the text slot and a transcript was placed for that step. When the caption failed, the transcript is already the step text, so no narration is added. This mirrors `_apply_transcript`. I added the two named tests, using a shared helper `_photo_build_with_captions`. `ruff check` and `ruff format` are clean. The full `pytest` run gave 552 passed and 5 skipped. I deselected all of `test_frozen_paths.py` (10 tests) instead of running it, so its two expected failures were not exercised. The two existing vision-caption tests named in the task pass unchanged.
